segments.ja233:1.1: Kāmaṃ yahiṃ icchasi tena gaccha, viddhosi mammamhi [mamasmi (ka.)] vikaṇṇakena;
segments.ja233:1.3: Hatosi bhattena suvāditena [savāditena (sī. syā. pī.)], lolo ca macche anubandhamāno.
segments.ja233:2.3: So haññati ñātisakhāna majjhe, macchānugo soriva suṃsumāroti [susumāro (ka.)].
